business_summary: Dynic Corporation produces and sells fabric and apparel products in Japan. It operates through three segments: Printing Information Related Business, Living Environment Related Business, and Packaging Related Business. It provides materials; publishing, stationery, and fancy products; print media supplies; nonwoven fabric products; apparel products comprising STAFLEX and PANELON fusible interlinings for garments, HARO shaping, and WELDEX interlinings for collars, as well as NIC SEVEN and CETUS care label materials; industrial products; special embossed products; foils, films, and paper products, as well as processed paper, paper tubes, and coating paper; and environmentally friendly products, as well as products for home. The company also offers book binding cloth, cloth for stationery paper goods, various bags/backpacks/purses made from simulated leather, computer ribbons, fine films, cloth for magnetic passbooks, various types of printing materials, business card and postcard printers, and moisture getters for organic ELs. In addition, it provides materials for automobile interiors; filters; fusible interlinings for clothing; and interior decorating items, such as carpets and wallpaper, tarpaulins, aluminum foils, and composite films for food containers. Dynic Corporation was formerly known as Nippon Cloth Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Dynic Corporation in 1974. Dynic Corporation was incorporated in 1919 and is based in Kyoto, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Dynic Corporation은 일본에서 직물 및 의류 제품을 생산 및 판매합니다. 인쇄정보 관련 사업, 생활환경 관련 사업, 포장 관련 사업의 3개 부문으로 운영됩니다. 자료를 제공합니다. 출판, 문구, 팬시 제품; 인쇄 매체 용품; 부직포 제품; 의류용 STAFLEX 및 PANELON 가용성 심지, HARO 쉐이핑, 칼라용 WELDEX 심지, NIC SEVEN 및 CETUS 케어 라벨 소재로 구성된 의류 제품; 산업용 제품; 특수 엠보싱 제품; 호일, 필름, 종이 제품, 가공지, 종이 튜브, 코팅지; 친환경 제품은 물론 가정용 제품까지. 이밖에도 제본천, 문구류용 천, 인조가죽으로 만든 각종 가방/배낭/지갑, 컴퓨터 리본, 고급 필름, 자기통장용 천, 각종 인쇄재료, 명함, 엽서 프린터, 유기 EL용 수분 게터 등도 판매하고 있다. 또한, 자동차 내장재 등을 공급하고 있습니다. 필터; 의류용 가용성 심지; 카펫, 벽장 등 인테리어 장식 품목
